2019.name: Mint Emoti Heads
2019.description: A revamped version of our original mint washi tape and the first of our Emoti Heads washi tape series! This is a 'permanent' roll that gets restocked repeatedly every few months so be on the lookout!

2019.name: Classic Animal Onesies
2019.description: We introduced our first 10mm washi line on Black Friday! A thinner version of our Classic Animal Onesies washi tape.

2019.name: Sunset Shimmer
2019.description: The second in our galaxy series! The background is a beautiful mix of pale pinks, oranges, peaches and yellows.

2019.name: Stitch & Friends
2019.description: Foil is a pretty blue colour that matches scrump! The letters OHANA are sprinkled in the background as a fun detail.

2019.name: Princess Party
2019.description: I definitely want to bring back a revamped version one day! This roll features 15 princesses on a fun, colourful gradient background.

2019.name: Winter Critters
2019.description: The second in our seasonal series! A beautiful pale blue with little foiled snowflake detailing.

2019.name: Fall Critters 1.0
2019.description: The beginning of our seasonal series! A beautiful orange to peach gradient with little foiled leaf detailing.

2019.name: Rainbow Onesies
2019.description: A super colourful roll for my 19th birthday sale event! Just looking at this roll makes me super happy :) The background is a perfect mid-tone Rainbow gradient.

2019.name: Twinkle Twinkle
2019.description: The beginning of our galaxy series! The background is a soft blend of blues, pinks, purples and white. Littered with foiled stars, clouds, and magical specks!

2019.name: Lavender Gradient Emotis
2019.description: Dabbling into some non-traditional foil colours! This simple design matches so many of my purple/pink spreads so I use it very often!

2019.name: Winnie & Friends 1.0
2019.description: Taking our brand growth into account, I believe this is our bestselling washi tape! Rightfully so as Winnie the Pooh holds a very special place in my childhood.

2019.name: Anniversary Pink Onesies
2019.description: Our first foiled washi tape! This roll was originally released for our anniversary event, then later brought back for a washi preorder.

2018.name: Winter Mint Emotis
2018.description: A beautiful blueish colour to compliment Powder Pink! This colour won second place in our preorder poll.

2018.name: Classic Animal Onesies
2018.description: The first animal onesie washi tape! We had a poll on the Facebook group at the time to vote on the preorder designs, and this pattern won first place by a landslide!

2018.name: Powder Pink Emotis
2018.description: The first in our emoti washi series! This roll was originally released for my 18th birthday, then later brought back for (our first) washi preorder.

2017.name: OG Mint Emoti Heads
2017.description: Our first ever washi tape! This is a rare one to come across as we produced only around 100. The background is a pale mint with white polka dots.
